brief:
Taybeh, the last all-Christian Palestinian town in the West Bank, has faced coordinated settler attacks that have created widespread fear among residents, Al Jazeera English reported. The historic community, which sits in the occupied territory, has endured multiple incidents of violence in recent months as tensions between Palestinian Christians and Israeli settlers have escalated.

Residents have reported property damage and direct confrontations during the attacks. Taybeh's status as the region's only entirely Christian-populated settlement has made it a target, according to accounts from community members. The town's vulnerability reflects broader patterns of settler violence across the West Bank, where Palestinian communities continue to report increased harassment and assaults.
dek: Historic Taybeh, a Palestinian Christian town in the occupied West Bank, targeted by settlers in coordinated attacks.
title: Settlers attack Taybeh, West Bank's sole Christian town
